scope: Baseline same-binary A/A only; no candidate comparison or gain claim
decision: PARK: 1M fails3 of6 preregistered blocks; no source proposal/implementation advancement
method: 6 fixed ABBA blocks per size,seeds1/2/3 twice; calibration target600ms; all48 original rows retained
gate: abs(Bsum-Asum)*100<=Asum AND each elapsed_ns>=10000000; equal operations and exact output/memory fingerprint
effect: 100*(Bsum-Asum)/Asum for display; negative means less elapsed in the inner pair of identical-binary processes
range: Observed window bounds, not uncertainty intervals or individual-query percentiles
backend: Codex/GPT-6 family; exact serving model/token/currency costs unknown
